unit.why: A narrative of R. Shneur Zalman of Liadi's arrest in Petersburg under Tsar Paul, his prediction of Paul's death, and his release by Alexander.
unit.boundary_note: opens by referring back to an earlier narrative ('כאשר כתבנו למעלה', the informer Avigdor) and forward to later chapters; stands as a self-contained episode

stories.start_quote: ויהי במשך איזה שנים אחרי׳ היה מוכרח
stories.summary_en: On a visit to Petersburg the Rabbi of Liadi is exposed by a careless merchant and imprisoned by Tsar Paul; from his cell he foresees Paul's death, and he is freed and honoured by Tsar Alexander on Hanukkah.

tags.why: Tsars Paul and Alexander imprison, then free and honour the rabbi
the central arc is the rabbi's prediction of the Tsar's death, which comes true
